The '''Chrelythiumn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Mortis monolith/Legends|Mortis monolith]] was located in this system.
